y-m-01-10.title: Kana ukabatanidza matriangle, matsvimbo ematchi mangani anodiwa?
y-m-01-10.goal: Tsvaga muchigadziriso chaSeohyeon kuti nei huwandu hwematsvimbo ematchi anodiwa husingakuri nehuwandu hwakafanana kana huwandu hwematriangle huchikura, uye ushandise pateni kufungidzira nyaya dzakakura.
y-m-01-10.material:
Unobatanidza matriangle mumutsara mumwe nematsvimbo ematchi. Matriangle ari padhuze anogovana tsvimbo yematchi imwe. Netriangle 1 unoda matsvimbo ematchi 3, netriangle 2 5, uye netriangle 3 7.
Huwandu hwematriangle | 1 | 2 | 3
Huwandu hwematsvimbo ematchi | 3 | 5 | 7
Seohyeon anoda kuziva kuti matsvimbo ematchi mangani anodiwa kuchimiro chakagadzirwa nekubatanidza matriangle 5.

y-m-01-10.thinking.1: Tsvaga pateni uye uishandise kunyaya hombe

y-m-01-10.s.s1.line.2: Saka kubatanidza matriangle 5, matsvimbo ematchi 15 anodiwa.
y-m-01-10.s.s1.explain: Mutsara 1 wakarurama. Mumutsara 2, Seohyeon akafunga kuti triangle imwe neimwe inoshandisa matsvimbo ematchi 3 zvakasiyana. Asi matriangle ari padhuze anogovana imwe, saka kana ukaiverenga zvakasiyana, tsvimbo inogovaniwa inoverengwa kaviri. Mutebhura, matriangle 2 anotora 5, kwete 6. Saka mutsara 2 nemutsara 3 zvose zvakaipa.

y-m-01-01.title: Tinogona kuvimba nenzira yaHajun yekuenzanisa hukuru kusvika papi?
y-m-01-01.topic: Kuenzanisa nhamba dze digit maviri (tens place ne ones place)
y-m-01-01.goal: Shandisa mienzaniso kutarisa kuti nzira yekusarudza hukuru hwenhamba dze digit maviri nekutarisa ones digit chete inokanganisa rini, uye utaure kuti nzvimbo ipi yekutarisa kutanga kana uchienzanisa hukuru.
y-m-01-01.material: Hajun anotamba mutambo wekugadzira nhamba mbiri dze digit maviri nemakadhi enhamba uye kufungidzira kuti ndeipi huru. Mu nhamba ye digit maviri, digit yekuruboshwe ndiyo 'tens place' (huwandu hwema bhandairi e10) uye digit yekurudyi ndiyo 'ones place' (huwandu hwezvega). Semuenzaniso, mu35 tens digit ndi3 uye ones digit ndi5. Pazasi ndiko kutsanangura kwakaita Hajun nzira yake.
y-m-01-01.thinking.0: Tonga kuti muenzaniso mumwe unoshanda wakakwana here kuvimba nenzira yose
y-m-01-01.thinking.1: Gadzira iwe pachako nyaya apo nzira inokundikana (muenzaniso unopikisa)
y-m-01-01.thinking.2: Sarudza kurongeka kwekuenzanisa uchishandisa place value
y-m-01-01.prereq.0: Kuverenga nhamba ye digit maviri sema bhandairi e10 nezvega (Grade 1, semester yechi2 kusvika nhanho ye Grade 2)
y-m-01-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara mumwe munyaya yaHajun wakaoma kuvimba nawo.
y-m-01-01.s.s1.hint.0: Kunhamba mbiri dziri mumutsara mumwe nemumwe, nyora kuti dzine ma bhandairi e10 mangani nezvega zvingani imwe neimwe.
y-m-01-01.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kuti pane nyaya apo nhamba ine ones digit huru nenhamba ine tens digit huru dzakapesana here, nekusarudza nhamba iwe pachako uye kuidzverenga nema marble.
y-m-01-01.s.s1.line.0: Enzanisa 35 ne32. Ones digit 5 yakakura kupfuura 2, saka 35 ndiyo nhamba huru.
y-m-01-01.s.s1.line.1: Enzanisa 27 ne41. Ones digit 7 yakakura kupfuura 1, saka 27 ndiyo nhamba huru.
y-m-01-01.s.s1.line.2: Saka kunhamba dze digit maviri, iya ine ones digit huru ndiyo nhamba huru.
y-m-01-01.s.s1.explain: Mhedzisiro yemutsara 1 (35 yakakura kupfuura 32) yakarurama. Asi izvozvo zvakangoitika nekuti tens digit dzenhamba mbiri dzakafanana, 3, saka ones digit ndidzo dzinosarudza. Mumutsara 2, 27 ine ma bhandairi e10 2 uye 41 ine ma bhandairi e10 4, saka 41 ndiyo nhamba huru. Mutsara 3 unotambanudza muenzaniso mumwe unoshanda kuti ufukidze nyaya dzose. Chero mutsara wawakasarudza, chakakosha ndechekutarisa zvinoitika kana ukatarisa ones digit chete kunhamba mbiri dzine tens digit dzakasiyana.
y-m-01-01.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira mapeya maviri akasiyana apo nzira yaHajun isingashande. Sarudza nhamba dze digit maviri a ne b zvekuti a idiki kupfuura b uye ones digit ya a yakakura kupfuura ones digit ya b.
y-m-01-01.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza a ne b zvekuti tens digit dzavo dzakasiyana. Zvingaita sei kuita kuti nhamba diki ive nezvega zvakawanda zvakasara?
y-m-01-01.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora nhamba mbiri dzako imwe neimwe sema bhandairi e10 nezvega, uye utarise kuti ndeipi huru chaizvo.
y-m-01-01.s.s2.var.a: Nhamba diki a (nhamba ye digit maviri)
y-m-01-01.s.s2.var.b: Nhamba huru b (nhamba ye digit maviri)
y-m-01-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Ndapota sarudza a se natural number kubva ku10 kusvika ku99.
y-m-01-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Ndapota sarudza b se natural number kubva ku10 kusvika ku99.
y-m-01-01.s.s2.fail.c3: a inofanira kuva nhamba diki kupfuura b.
y-m-01-01.s.s2.ok.c4: Ones digit ya a yakakura. Kushandisa nzira yaHajun, waizoti zvisina kururama kuti a yakakura.
y-m-01-01.s.s2.fail.c4: Ones digit ya a inofanira kuva huru kupfuura ones digit ya b.
y-m-01-01.s.s2.explain: Semuenzaniso, mu19 ne30 ones digit 9 yakakura kupfuura 0, asi 30 ine ma bhandairi e10 3, saka yakakura kupfuura 19. Kana tens digit dzakasiyana, ones digit haigoni kusarudza hukuru chero ichikura sei. Nzira yaHajun inogona kushandiswa chete kana tens digit dzakafanana.
y-m-01-01.s.s3.prompt: Kana uchienzanisa hukuru hwenhamba mbiri dze digit maviri, chii chakanakisa kutarisa kutanga?
y-m-01-01.s.s3.hint.0: Kumapeya maviri awakangogadzira, nyora padivi pemumwe kurongeka kwawakasarudza nekutarisa ones digit chete nekurongeka chaiko kwekuti nhamba ipi yakakura.
y-m-01-01.s.s3.hint.1: Sarudza peya imwe yenhamba dzine tens digit dzakafanana uye peya imwe ine tens digit dzakasiyana, uye uenzanise kuti nzvimbo ipi inosarudza hukuru.
y-m-01-01.s.s3.o.a: Tarisa tens digit kutanga, uye kana dzakafanana, tarisa ones digit
y-m-01-01.s.s3.r.a: Pfungwa ndeyekuti ma bhandairi e gumi mangani anotanga, uye zvega zvinosarudza chete kana huwandu hwema bhandairi hwakafanana.
y-m-01-01.s.s3.o.b: Wedzera ma digit maviri enhamba imwe neimwe uye usarudze iya ine huwandu hwakakura
y-m-01-01.s.s3.r.b: Huwandu hwema digit hunogona kusiyana nehukuru hwenhamba. Enzanisa 19 (1 ne9) ne30 (3 ne0).
y-m-01-01.s.s3.o.c: Mhedzisiro yakafanana chero digit ipi yaunotarisa kutanga
y-m-01-01.s.s3.r.c: Mhedzisiro inogona kuchinja zvichienderana nekuti unotarisa nzvimbo ipi kutanga. Enzanisa mhedzisiro yenzira mbiri dzenhamba 27 ne41.
y-m-01-01.s.s3.o.d: Tarisa ones digit kutanga, uye kana dzakafanana, tarisa tens digit
y-m-01-01.s.s3.r.d: Tarisa zvinoitika kana ukashandisa kurongeka uku kumienzaniso yawakangogadzira. Kana tens digit dzakasiyana, ones digit haigoni kusarudza kuti ndeipi yakakura.
y-m-01-01.s.s3.explain: Kunhamba dze digit maviri, iya ine ma bhandairi e10 akawanda ndiyo nhamba huru. Chete kana huwandu hwema bhandairi hwakafanana ndipo zvega zvinosarudza. Ndosaka tichitarisa tens place kutanga.

y-m-01-06.s.s2.prompt: Pakati penhamba dzine madhijiti matatu dzakagadzirwa nekushandisa kadhi rega rega re 0, 4, ne 7 kamwe, wana nhamba nhatu dzakasiyana dzakakura kupfuura 450. Isa hundreds digit a, tens digit b, ne ones digit c.
y-m-01-06.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza kuti makadhi api anogona kuenda mu hundreds place, wobva wanyora nhamba dzose dzaunogona kugadzira nemamwe makadhi maviri.
y-m-01-06.s.s2.hint.1: Enzanisa nhamba dzawakanyora ne 450 uye usarudze dzakakura chete.
y-m-01-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Unogona kushandisa makadhi 0, 4, ne 7 chete sema digits.
y-m-01-06.s.s2.ok.c2: Wakashandisa kadhi rega rega kamwe chete.
y-m-01-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Haugone kushandisa kadhi rimwechete kaviri. Kune kadhi rimwe chete re rimwe nerimwe.
y-m-01-06.s.s2.ok.c3: Hundreds digit haisi 0. I nhamba ine madhijiti matatu.
y-m-01-06.s.s2.fail.c3: Kana hundreds digit i 0, haisi nhamba ine madhijiti matatu.
y-m-01-06.s.s2.explain: Nhamba dzine madhijiti matatu dzaunogona kugadzira nemakadhi 0, 4, ne 7 i ina: 407, 470, 704, ne 740. Pakati pazvo, nhamba dzakakura kupfuura 450 i nhatu: 470, 704, ne 740. 407 i shoma kupfuura 450, saka yasiiwa.
y-m-01-06.s.s3.prompt: Kana makadhi i 0, 0, ne 7, unogona kugadzira nhamba dzine madhijiti matatu dzingani uchishandisa makadhi ose matatu?
y-m-01-06.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza kuti kadhi ripi rinogona kuenda mu hundreds place.
y-m-01-06.s.s3.hint.1: Tarisa kana nhamba inochinja kana ukachinjanisa makadhi maviri mamwe.
y-m-01-06.s.s3.r.a: 070 ne 007 zvine 0 mu hundreds place. Tarisazve kana dzichiverengwa senhamba dzine madhijiti matatu.
y-m-01-06.s.s3.r.b: Pfungwa iyi yakashandisa mamiriro ekuti 0 haifaniri kuenda mu hundreds place kumamiriro ane makadhi maviri akafanana zvakare.
y-m-01-06.s.s3.r.c: Unogona kunge wakatonga usina kuedza kana unogona kuisa 7 mu hundreds place.
y-m-01-06.s.s3.r.d: 070 ine 0 mu hundreds place, saka yakafanana ne 70. Tarisa kana i nhamba ine madhijiti matatu chaizvo.
y-m-01-06.s.s3.explain: 7 inofanira kuenda mu hundreds place, uye makadhi maviri 0 asara anopa 700 imwechete kunyange ukachinjanisa nhevedzano yawo. Saka imwe chete, 700, ndiyo inogona kugadzirwa. Kana makadhi akafanana, kuchinjanisa nhevedzano kunopa nhamba imwechete.

y-m-01-02.title: Chii chinoitika kana ukaisa pamwe chete nhamba yeodd nenhamba yeodd?
y-m-01-02.topic: Huwandu hwema odd ne even number (kuedza kuita mapeya)
y-m-01-02.goal: Ona kuti kuvimba kunochinja sei kana mienzaniso ichiwedzera uye kana uchidzidza chikonzero, uye utevere pfungwa inotsanangura nekuita mapeya kuti nei kuisa nhamba mbiri dze odd pamwe chete kunopa nhamba ye even.
y-m-01-02.material: Kana ukaita mapeya ema marble maviri maviri, kana rimwe rasara huwandu hwema marble 'ndehwe odd', uye kana pasina rasara 'ndehwe even'. 3 peya imwe uye rimwe rinosara, saka ye odd, uye 8 mapeya mana, saka ye even. Seoa anoda kuziva kuti kuisa huwandu hwe odd hwema marble nehuwandu hwe odd hwema marble pamwe chete panzvimbo imwe kunopa huwandu hwe odd kana hwe even hwema marble zvose.
y-m-01-02.thinking.0: Cherekedza musiyano wekuvimba pakati pemuenzaniso mumwe nemienzaniso yakawanda
y-m-01-02.thinking.1: Tarisa kuti kuziva chikonzero kunokubvumira kutakura kufunga kwako kunyaya itsva
y-m-01-02.thinking.2: Gadzira mapeya akawanda ane huwandu hwakapihwa
y-m-01-02.prereq.0: Kuedza kuita mapeya maviri maviri (nhanho ye Grade 1 kusvika 2)
y-m-01-02.prereq.1: Zvinoreva odd ne even (kuti pane chasara kana kwete)
y-m-01-02.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza kuti kufunga kwako kunochinja sei nguva imwe neimwe ruzivo rutsva rwunoonekwa.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.hint.0: Padanho rimwe nerimwe, kutanga sarudza pfungwa yako mumutsara mumwe, wobva waenzanisa kuti ruzivo rutsva runoita kuti pfungwa iyoyo ive yakasimba kana kuidengenyedza.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.hint.1: Paradzanisa kuti chaonekwa 'muenzaniso' kana 'chikonzero', uye funga kuti chipi chakachinja kuvimba kwako zvakanyanya.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.0.info: Seoa akaisa ma marble 3 nema marble 5 pamwe chete panzvimbo imwe akawana 8. 8 ndeye even.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.0.ask: Unofungei nepfungwa yekuti 'kuisa nhamba ye odd nenhamba ye odd pamwe chete kunopa nhamba ye even'?
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Muenzaniso mumwe unobatsira kugadzira fungidziro, asi hauvimbisi nyaya dzose. Iyedze zvakanyanya nedzimwe odd number.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Zvinoita sekuti kuisa ma odd number pamwe chete kunopa nhamba ye odd
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Mhedzisiro yekuisa 3 ne5 pamwe chete, 8, ndeye even. Pfungwa iyi haienderani nemuenzaniso iwoyo.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Zvino ndine chokwadi kuti inogara iri even
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Pfungwa iyi inovimbisa nyaya dzose kubva pamuenzaniso mumwe chete. Tarisa shure kuti wakayedzawo dzimwe odd number here.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Pane muenzaniso mumwe chete, saka ndinoda kutarisa nedzimwe odd number zvakare
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Pfungwa iyi inoona kuti muenzaniso mumwe chete haugoni kukuudza kuti zvinogara zvakadaro here.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Zvinoita sekuti ichava even, asi handisati ndava nechokwadi
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Pfungwa iyi inogadzira fungidziro asi inoramba ichisava nechokwadi.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.1.info: Seoa akaedza zvakawanda. 1 ne 1 zvinoita 2, 7 ne 9 zvinoita 16, 11 ne 13 zvinoita 24, uye 21 ne 35 zvinoita 56. Zvese zvakaenzana.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.1.after: Kana mienzaniso mizhinji ichishanda, kutenda kwako kunokura. Asi haugoni kuedza nhamba dzese dzisina kuenzana, saka kuziva 'kuti sei zvakadaro' ndiro danho rinotevera.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Handigoni kutenda nokuti mienzaniso mishoma yakashanda
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Pfungwa iyi inoremekedza zvishoma simba rekuunganidza mienzaniso. Kana mienzaniso ichishanda, kutenda kunogona kukura.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Kuisa nhamba dzisina kuenzana pamwe chete dzimwe nguva kunopa nhamba yakaenzana uye dzimwe nguva isina kuenzana
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Pakati pemienzaniso yakaedzwa, nhamba isina kuenzana haina kuuya kunyange kamwe chete.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Mienzaniso mizhinji yakashanda, saka kutenda kwangu kuti inogara yakaenzana kwakura
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Mienzaniso yakaunganidzwa uye kutenda kwakakura. Asi nyaya dzisina kuedzwa dzichiripo.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Handisati ndaedza nyaya dzese, saka ndinoda kuziva chikonzero
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Pfungwa iyi inoona kuti kunyange nemienzaniso mizhinji, chokwadi chine muganho kana usingazivi chikonzero.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.2.info: Seoa akawana chikonzero. Kana ukaronga mabhora akawanda asina kuenzana maviri maviri, rimwe rinosara. Kana ukaisa marara maviri emabhora akawanda asina kuenzana panzvimbo imwe, mabhora maviri akasara anova maviri pamwe chete. (3 ndi ○○ ○ uye 5 ndi ○○ ○○ ○, saka rimwe rinosara pakupedzisira.)
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: Tsananguro iyi inogona kushandiswa kana pane mabhora akawanda zvikuru (101 ne 203) here?
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.2.after: Tsananguro inoshandisa poindi yokuti 'kana yaronga maviri maviri, rimwe rinosara' chete, zvisinei nehuwandu hwemabhora, saka inogona kushandiswawo kunhamba huru.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Inoshanda kunhamba diki chete, uye kunhamba huru unofanira kuaisa pamwe chete kuti uwane
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Funga kana tsananguro ichishanduka nehuwandu hwemabhora. Tarisa kana huwandu hwemabhora asara huchiramba huri chimwe chete nhamba painokura.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Nenhamba huru, bhora rimwe kana kupfuura rinogona kusara
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Kana yaronga maviri maviri, chinosara 0 kana 1. Hachishanduki kana nhamba dzakura.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Pfungwa iyi inorega kutonga pasina kufunga kuti tsananguro inoshanda rinhi.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Chinosara chigara chiri bhora rimwe, saka inogona kushandiswawo kunhamba huru
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Pfungwa iyi inovimba nechikonzero chokuti 'rimwe rinosara nguva dzese,' kwete nesaizi yenhamba.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.3.info: Seoa akaisa pamwe chete mavara matatu emabhora akawanda asina kuenzana (3, 5, ne 7) uye akawana 15. 15 haina kuenzana.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.3.ask: Chii chinoitika kana ukaisa pamwe chete mavara matatu emabhora akawanda asina kuenzana? Ungashandisa sei pfungwa yapfuura?
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.3.after: Kana pane mabhora matatu akasara, maviri anova maviri uye rimwe rinosara. Saka huwandu hwose husina kuenzana. Kana uchiziva chikonzero, unogona kufungidzira nyaya nyowani pasina kuunganidza mienzaniso.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.3.o.a: Kare, nhamba dzisina kuenzana dzakaisirwa pamwe chete dzakapa nhamba yakaenzana, saka panguva ino zvinoratidzika kuti ichava yakaenzanawo
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.3.r.a: Pfungwa iyi yakatakura mhedzisiro yemavara maviri zvakananga kumavara matatu. Verenga kuti pane mabhora asara mangani.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.3.o.b: Zvinoratidzika kuti ichagara isina kuenzana, zvisinei kuti mavara mangani
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.3.r.b: Nemavara maviri yakaenzana. Tarisa kana mhedzisiro ichigona kushanduka zvichienderana nehuwandu hwemavara.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.3.o.c: Mavara maviri anoita nhamba yakaenzana, saka kuwedzera rimwe vara zvakare kunoratidzika kuchiita nhamba isina kuenzana
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.3.r.c: Pfungwa iyi inoenderera ichishandisa chikonzero chakadzidzwa kare kunyaya nyowani.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.3.o.d: Ndinogona kuziva nekuedza mienzaniso yakawanda chete
y-m-01-02.s.s1.st.3.r.d: Kuedza mienzaniso yakawanda nzira yakanakawo. Funga zvakare kana unogona kufungidzira pasina kuedza mienzaniso uchishandisa chikonzero.
y-m-01-02.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga, ndakangofungidzira kubva pamuenzaniso mumwe chete, kutenda kwangu kwakakura mienzaniso painowedzera, uye pandakaziva chikonzero ndaigona kutaura kunyange nezvenhamba huru zvikuru. Kuziva chikonzero kwakandibvumira kutakura kufunga kwangu kunyaya nyowani (mavara matatu). Taura kuti chokwadi chako chakava chakasimba padanho ripi uye chii chakakuita.
y-m-01-02.s.s2.prompt: Tsvaga maviri maviri akasiyana matatu enhamba mbiri dzisina kuenzana dzine huwandu hwe 20. Daidza nhamba diki kuti a uye nhamba huru kuti b.
y-m-01-02.s.s2.hint.0: Tarisa kana, kana wasarudza nhamba imwe, imwe yasarudzwa pachayo.
y-m-01-02.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa kuti nhamba mbiri dzawakasarudza dzese hadzina kuenzana, uye kuti kana dzaronga maviri maviri rimwe rinosara kubva kune rimwe nerimwe.

y-m-01-02.s.s3.prompt: Unogona kuisa nhamba mbiri dzisina kuenzana pamwe chete kuti uwane huwandu hwe 21 here?
y-m-01-02.s.s3.hint.0: Tarisa kana nhamba dzawakawana kubva pakuisa pamwe chete mumaviri awakangowana dzakambova dzisina kuenzana.
y-m-01-02.s.s3.hint.1: Patsanura mabhora 21 kuva mavara maviri emabhora akawanda asina kuenzana, aronge maviri maviri, uye uverenge chinosara.
y-m-01-02.s.s3.o.a: Hazvigoni. Kuisa nhamba mbiri dzisina kuenzana pamwe chete kunopa nhamba yakaenzana

y-m-01-02.s.s3.r.d: Kana uchiziva chikonzero, unogona kutonga pasina kuedza nyaya dzese.
y-m-01-02.s.s3.explain: Kana ukaisa nhamba mbiri dzisina kuenzana pamwe chete, mabhora maviri asara anova maviri, saka huwandu hwose hwakaenzana. 21 haina kuenzana, saka haigoni kuitwa nekuisa nhamba mbiri dzisina kuenzana pamwe chete.
y-m-01-02.s.s3.acc.0: Kutsvaga mienzaniso uye kupedza kuti hapana kana pasina inobuda pfungwa ine nheyo dzimwe. Asi unogona kuitaura mukati mehuwandu hwawakatsvaga chete, uye kana uchiziva chikonzero (kuronga maviri maviri), unogona kuva nechokwadi nenhamba dzese dzisina kuenzana.

y-m-01-05.title: Shamwari dzakamira mumutsetse dzakawanda sei zvose?
y-m-01-05.topic: Nhamba dzenhevedzano nehuwandu hwose (nzvimbo ipi, vanhu vangani zvose)
y-m-01-05.goal: Dzidza kuti 'nzvimbo ipi' ne 'vanhu vangani' zvine zvinoreva zvakasiyana, shandisa chokwadi chekuti munhu mumwe ari mukuverenga kubva pamberi nekubva shure kuti uzive kuti ruzivo rupi runokuita kuti uwane huwandu hwose uye rupi harutiite, uye usiyanise huwandu hwevanhu vakamira pakati pevanhu vaviri nemusiyano wenhamba dzavo.
y-m-01-05.material: Vanhu vakamira mumutsetse mumwe pamberi pe amusement park ride. Jihu akamira wechi 5 kubva pamberi uye wechi 4 kubva shure. Seoha akaverenga uye akatsanangura vanhu vangani vari mumutsetse zvose.
y-m-01-05.thinking.2: Kugadzira mamiriro akati wandei anoenderana nehuwandu hwevanhu vakamira pakati
y-m-01-05.prereq.0: Kutaura nhevedzano yekutanga, yechipiri, ... nekuverenga munhu mumwe panguva imwe (Grade 1 level)
y-m-01-05.prereq.1: Kuverenga nhamba kusvika ku 12 nekutaura nhevedzano yadzo
y-m-01-05.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse wekutanga usina kururama mutsananguro yaSeoha.
y-m-01-05.s.s1.hint.0: Dhonza mutsetse semabhokisi, ratidza bhokisi raJihu, uye uronge nhamba kubva pamberi.
y-m-01-05.s.s1.hint.1: Pamufananidzo wemutsetse, ratidza nzvimbo apo wakaverenga vanhu 5 nenzvimbo apo wakaverenga vanhu 4 nepenzura dzemavara akasiyana, uye uverenge kuti nzvimbo dzakaratidzwa dzingani zvose.
y-m-01-05.s.s1.line.0: Jihu i wechi 5 kubva pamberi uye wechi 4 kubva shure.
y-m-01-05.s.s1.line.1: Kubva pamberi kusvika kuna Jihu i vanhu 5, uye kubva shure kusvika kuna Jihu i vanhu 4.
y-m-01-05.s.s1.line.2: Kana ukawedzera vanhu 5 nevanhu 4, munhu wese anoverengwa kamwe chete, saka i vanhu 9.
y-m-01-05.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 2 wakarurama. Kuverenga kubva pamberi kusvika kuna Jihu i vanhu 5 kusanganisira Jihu, uye kuverenga kubva shure kusvika kuna Jihu i vanhu 4 kusanganisira Jihu zvakare. Mumutsetse 3 yakati kuwedzera nhamba mbiri kunoverenga munhu wese kamwe chete, asi Jihu akaverengwa kaviri. Saka mutsetse 3 ndiwo mutsetse wekutanga usina kururama, uye mutsetse 4 unoenderera nemutengo uyu usina kururama. Kana Jihu akaverengwa kamwe chete, huwandu hwose i vanhu 8.
y-m-01-05.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza ruzivo rwose runokuita kuti uzive kuti vanhu vangani vari mumutsetse zvose. Funga nezve rimwe nerimwe zvakaparadzana.
y-m-01-05.s.s2.hint.0: Kune chidimbu cheruzivo chimwe nechimwe, dhonza mutsetse semabhokisi uye uratidze, wobva watarisa kana huwandu hwemabhokisi hwakasarudzwa.
y-m-01-05.s.s2.hint.1: Siyanisa mamiriro apo huwandu hwemabhokisi hwakasarudzwa seimwe chete nemamiriro apo kune zvingaitika zvakawanda mushure mekuratidza.
y-m-01-05.s.s2.r.a: Kungoziva wechi 5 kubva pamberi, hauzive kuti vanhu vangani vari shure kwaJihu. Funga kana unogona kuziva huwandu hwevanhu vakamira shure.
y-m-01-05.s.s2.o.b: Hapana ari shure, uye Jihu i wechi 5 kubva pamberi
y-m-01-05.s.s2.r.b: Izvi zvakashandisa chokwadi chekuti Jihu i wekupedzisira. Kana munhu wechi 5 kubva pamberi ari wekupedzisira, huwandu hwevanhu pamberi hwakasarudzwa.
y-m-01-05.s.s2.o.c: Jihu i wechi 5 kubva pamberi uye wechi 4 kubva shure
y-m-01-05.s.s2.r.c: Funga kana kuziva zvose nzvimbo yepamberi neyeshure yemunhu mumwe kunosarudza huwandu hwose.
y-m-01-05.s.s2.o.d: Kune vanhu 4 pamberi pa Jihu nevanhu 3 shure
y-m-01-05.s.s2.r.d: Pfungwa iyi yakaverenga nekuwedzera Jihu, munhu mumwe, kuhuwandu hwevanhu vari pamberi neshure.
y-m-01-05.s.s2.explain: Mu b, Jihu i wekupedzisira, saka wechi 5 kubva pamberi i vanhu 5 zvose. Mu c, kana ukaverenga Jihu kamwe chete, i vanhu 8. Mu d, 4 pamberi, 1 Jihu, ne 3 shure zvinoita vanhu 8. Mu a, hauzive kuti vanhu vangani vari shure kwaJihu, saka haugone kuziva huwandu hwose.
y-m-01-05.s.s3.prompt: Vanhu 12 vakamira mumutsetse. Fungidzira kuti vanhu 3 chaizvo vakamira pakati peshamwari mbiri. Kana shamwari yepamberi i wechi a kubva pamberi uye shamwari yeshure i wechi b kubva pamberi, wana mapeya matatu akasiyana anogoneka a, b.
y-m-01-05.s.s3.hint.0: Dhonza shamwari mbiri se ○ uye vanhu 3 vakamira pakati pavo se △, uye uzviise mumutsetse mumwe.

y-m-01-14.title: Pane nzvimbo dzingani pakati pemiti?
y-m-01-14.topic: Kuenzanisa huwandu hwemiti nehuwandu hwenzvimbo dziri pakati (mutsetse mumwe nechimiro chakatenderera)
y-m-01-14.goal: Nzwisisa kuti huwandu hwemiti yakasimwa mumutsetse nehuwandu hwenzvimbo dziri pakati pemiti hazvina kufanana, uye utsanangurire munin'ina kuti huwandu hwenzvimbo hunoshanduka sei kana miti ikasimwa mudenderedzwa.
y-m-01-14.material: Miti yakasimwa mumutsetse mumwe parutivi rumwe rwemugwagwa. Chikamu chiri pakati pemuti mumwe nomumwe unotevera chinodaidzwa kuti 'nzvimbo.' Kana pane miti 4, pane nzvimbo 3. Kana pane miti 3, pane nzvimbo 2.
y-m-01-14.thinking.1: Tonga kuti hukama hunoshanduka sei kana mamiriro achichinja
y-m-01-14.prereq.0: Kuziva kuti nzvimbo pakati pemiti chii
y-m-01-14.prereq.1: Kuverenga nhamba nenzira nekuverenga tafura nyore (padanho reGiredhi 1 kusvika 2)
y-m-01-14.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza nzira dzese dzakakodzera dzekuwana huwandu hwenzvimbo kana pane miti 10.
y-m-01-14.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora patafura huwandu hwenzvimbo kana pane miti 2, 3, ne 4.
y-m-01-14.s.s1.hint.1: Gadzira peya yemuti mumwe nenzvimbo imwe panguva imwe uye utarise kuti rutivi rupi runosara pasina mumwe wayo.
y-m-01-14.s.s1.o.a: Tora huwandu hwemiti nenzvimbo sezvakafanana uye utaure nzvimbo 10
y-m-01-14.s.s1.r.a: Tarisa kana izvi zvichiwirirana nemienzaniso yapfuura: miti 4 inoita nzvimbo 3 uye miti 3 inoita nzvimbo 2.
y-m-01-14.s.s1.o.b: Tsvaga patafura kuti nzvimbo dzingani dzinowedzerwa pese painowedzera miti ne 1
y-m-01-14.s.s1.r.b: Pfungwa iyi inowana muenzaniso nekutarisa shanduko kana nhamba ichikwira ne 1.
y-m-01-14.s.s1.o.c: Batanidza miti 10 maviri maviri uye utaure nzvimbo 5
y-m-01-14.s.s1.r.c: Kubatanidza miti 4 maviri maviri kunopa mabhandi 2. Tarisa kana zvichiwirirana nemuenzaniso wapfuura (nzvimbo 3).
y-m-01-14.s.s1.o.d: Siya muti wekutanga uye uone kuti muti wega wega wasara une nzvimbo imwe pamberi pawo
y-m-01-14.s.s1.r.d: Pfungwa iyi inoona kuti kana ukaita peya yemiti nenzvimbo imwe imwe, muti mumwe unosara pasina mumwe wawo.
y-m-01-14.s.s1.explain: Kana miti ichiwedzera ne 1, nzvimbo dzinowedzerawo ne 1, saka huwandu hwenzvimbo hushoma ne 1 pane huwandu hwemiti. Saka miti 10 inoita nzvimbo 9. b inzira yekuwana nhamba inowedzerwa patafura, uye d inzira yekuita peya woona kuti rimwe rinosara.

y-m-01-14.s.s2.fail.c2: Hahusi huwandu hwenzvimbo hunowirirana nehuwandu hwemiti iwoyo. Enzanisa nekuti miti 4 yakaita sei nzvimbo 3.
y-m-01-14.s.s2.explain: Mumutsetse mumwe, huwandu hwenzvimbo hushoma ne 1 pane huwandu hwemiti. Miti 5 inoita nzvimbo 4, miti 10 inoita nzvimbo 9, uye miti 20 inoita nzvimbo 19. Izvi nokuti kana ukaita peya yenzvimbo imwe nemuti wega wega, muti wekupedzisira hauna nzvimbo yekuita nayo peya.

y-m-01-14.s.s3.hint.0: Isa miti 6 mudenderedzwa uye uverenge imwe imwe kuti pane nzvimbo dzingani apo pane nzvimbo pakati pemuti mumwe nowotevera.
